title: Best and meanest things said about him
summary: He is happiest when people enjoy his writing.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: What's the meanest thing ever said about you?
The meanest thing? I don't know. There have been a lot of mean things said about me, I don't know which the meanest was.
What's the best thing ever said about you? What are you most proud of somebody saying about you?
When she says I love you, that's when I'm the most proud.
He makes me feel so powerful.
You can write that by Johnny Carson audition.

I'm always pleased when people say they enjoy my writing, that always pleases me. Wouldn't that please anyone, to have his work appreciated? It makes things worthwhile. That's where the important values are.
